posts.title: Fired for Speaking Up: The Exemption Is a Claim, Not a Verdict
posts.caption:
THE EXEMPTION IS A CLAIM, NOT A VERDICT. 📄
When they name an exemption, check whether it fits. An exemption covers the record it names, not the whole file. The law asks for the rest to be separated out and handed over.
Ask for the log too, the list that shows what was held back and why. Then read the exemption against the record itself. If the words do not match the paper, say so in writing, and ask again.
Follow for the full paper trail, and read the 209connect newsletter for the documents behind the story. Link in bio.
